note: Independent re-judgment against RFC 5176 Section 2.3 and HEAD code (coa.go replayKey, cachedReplay, rememberReplay). TestRFC5176DuplicateRequestAnsweredFromCache and TestRFC5176DuplicateIsSameSourcePortAndIdentifier send identical Disconnect-Requests on one client socket and assert identical cached response octets and one teardown, while a new Identifier on the same socket runs afresh (two teardowns). TestRFC5176DifferentSourcePortIsNotADuplicate proves a second source port runs afresh (two teardowns), and TestRFC5176SameTripleNewAuthenticatorIsProcessedAfresh proves a new Request Authenticator on the same triple runs afresh and replaces the entry while a stale discarded copy preserves it.
